**3811 Ekkocardiografi, avanceret undersøgelse** (Advanced Echocardiography Examination) is a specific procedure code registered in the [[sygesikringsregisteret|Sygesikringsregisteret]] (Danish Health Service Register) [^src1]. It is utilized within the Danish healthcare system to identify and track advanced echocardiographic examinations, playing a critical role in the national quality measurement and clinical auditing of atrial fibrillation care [^src1]. 

As part of the broader diagnostic framework for cardiovascular diseases, this specific code distinguishes advanced imaging from standard procedures, such as [[3810-ekkocardiografi-standardundersoegelse|3810 Ekkocardiografi, standardundersøgelse]] [^src1]. The Sygesikringsregisteret maintains a comprehensive list of echocardiography-related codes to ensure precise data collection for clinical quality databases. Alongside code 3811, the register includes several other related procedural identifiers, such as [[2208-ekkocardiografi|2208 Ekkocardiografi]], [[5101-ekko-cardiografi|5101 EKKO-cardiografi]], [[5102-transsofageal-ekko|5102 Transsøfofagal ekko.]], [[5103-stress-ekkocardiogra|5103 Stress ekkocardiogra]], [[6402-ekkocardiografi|6402 Ekkocardiografi]], [[6408-ekkocardiografi|6408 Ekkocardiografi]], and [[0906-ekko-kardiografi|0906 Ekko-kardiografi]] [^src1]. 

In clinical quality reports, the general procedure of [[ekkokardiografi|Ekkokardiografi]] is mapped to or coded as this specific identifier when an advanced examination is performed [^src2]. This standardized coding enables the Regionernes Kliniske Kvalitetsudviklingsprogram (RKKP) to systematically measure denominator and numerator metrics for quality indicators, ensuring that patients with atrial fibrillation receive appropriate and timely diagnostic imaging.
